withdrawDemo.title: M-Pesa off-ramp (demo)
withdrawDemo.body: After a Bitika buy, sats sit in your Breez wallet. To cash out to M-Pesa, PesaSense pays your phone’s bitcoin.co.ke Lightning address (07…@bitcoin.co.ke). bitcoin.co.ke settles KES to your line.
withdrawDemo.note: Demo only — example {sats} sats to 0712345678@bitcoin.co.ke. A real withdraw needs sats in your wallet after a filled buy.

withdraw.title: Withdraw to M-Pesa
withdraw.step1: Copy the address below or scan the QR code with your phone.
withdraw.step2: Open your Lightning wallet — Wallet of Satoshi, Blink, Breez, or any other.
withdraw.step3: Send your sats to this address. bitcoin.co.ke converts them to KES on your M-Pesa.
withdraw.submitted: Payment submitted from your PesaSense wallet. KES should arrive on M-Pesa after bitcoin.co.ke settles.
withdraw.sendTrail: to this address. If the wallet app does not open, use Copy address instead.
